lines: Day seven. It began with a song.
Felix Kagr of the Concord sang on night watch.
From across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
In the morning, a Hegemony sniper found him. Wendel Freddie.
At R-F nine, Silas Samhatespeac shot the Hegemony sniper Leopold Shadowizard.
Before noon, a machine gun found Silas too.
Rafael Superfeisty had started a game of chess by post. He sent his first move home.
The answer is on its way. Rafael is not.
Seventeen men fell. Ten Concord, nine of them shot. Seven Hegemony.
From the tree on Hill 304, Hegemony spotters called out every head. Thirty-two Concord men were hit.
Both sides voted for the same thing. Concrete.
The pillboxes went up today. From tomorrow, their machine guns fire harder.
The race for Blackwater Canal. Concord twenty-eight, Hegemony fourteen. First to one hundred enemy dead takes it.
Silas's nephew, Severin, took his post at R-F nine.
He found his uncle's initials in the wall, and carved his own beneath them. The same letters.
Yesterday, forty-two new soldiers came up the line.
Four hundred and sixty-six now hold the front.
Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD to enlist.
Your name goes on the line.
